title: FHFA House Price Index — monthly index (April 2027), 9:00 a.m. ET
source: FHFA: both primaries the confirmed-tier prefix names, fetched direct 2026-09-08 by this event's own initial research rather than inherited from the proposal. (1) fhfa.gov/data/hpi (HTTP 200, 89,663 bytes) -- its 'FHFA HPI Release Dates' section, whose 2027 table carries twelve dated rows Jan 26 -> Dec 28; the row for this id reads verbatim 'Tuesday, June 29 | Monthly Index | April 2027', the sixth of the twelve. (2) The published 2026Q2 report (fhfa.gov/document/d/hpi/fhfa-house-price-index-report-2026q2, HTTP 200, 1,522,949 bytes; 517 content streams located, 511 inflated in-session with node zlib), whose 'FHFA HPI Release Dates for 2027' appendix page carries the identical row above the sentence 'Public FHFA HPI(R) releases occur at 9AM ET and include a press release, tables, figures, and associated data' -- the source of the 9:00 a.m. ET time. THE EDITION TYPE IS QUOTED, NOT ASSUMED: the same table marks exactly four 2027 rows quarterly (February 23, May 25, August 31, November 30), so this is a monthly edition by the publisher's own labelling. Promoted estimate -> confirmed on the precedent seven sibling lanes have set: the no-self-confirm rule binds the sweep that DISCOVERED an event -- here fhfa-hpi-2027-11-30 -- and this is the independent second look. notes: CANONICAL FILE WRITTEN BY THIS EVENT'S OWN INITIAL RESEARCH (2026-09-08); ledger docs/research/events/fhfa-hpi-2027-06-29.md. THE MAIN FINDING IS A CORRECTION TO THE METRIC THREE SIBLING LEDGERS RANK CLEANLINESS BY, AND IT REVERSES THIS DATE'S HEADLINE. On distance to the nearest FOMC MEETING day this is the cleanest June the posted calendar has ever produced: 20 days from 2027-06-09, against a June base of 13/13/13/13/6/13 for 2021-2026 and a 67-release distribution whose median is 13 and whose maximum is 21. The cause is arithmetic -- June 2027 has five Tuesdays (June 1 is one), the Board opened on the second (June 8-9) and FHFA prints on the fifth (June 29), the widest configuration June can produce. BUT THAT METRIC COUNTS ONLY HALF THE FED'S DATED VOICE. Applying the Board's own verbatim rule from federalreserve.gov/monetarypolicy/fomccalendars.htm (HTTP 200, 164,831 bytes, 'Last Update: August 19, 2026') -- 'The minutes of regularly scheduled meetings are released three weeks after the date of the policy decision' -- to all 56 posted meeting pairs and re-running the same 67 releases: the median distance falls from 13 days to 6 and the maximum from 21 to 13. February, which fhfa-hpi-2027-02-23 calls 'the cleanest session the FHFA calendar produces', is 6 days from a minutes release 6 of 6. AND THIS DATE GOES FROM 20 DAYS TO ONE: the June 8-9 minutes land 2027-06-30, the morning after. Only 2 of 67 releases since 2021 have sat within a day of a minutes release; in 2027 only this date and 2027-12-28 do. THE SESSION IS THE MOST CROWDED ON THE FHFA CALENDAR, not the cleanest: four tracked ids inside five days (russell-reconstitution-2027-06-25, consumer-confidence-2027-06-29 at 10:00 the same morning, fomc-minutes-2027-06-30, sp-select-sector-secondary-reweight-2027-06-30), a fifth proposed in this PR, and seven inside fourteen -- against the one id fhfa-hpi-2027-08-31 found in its whole corridor. TAPE: 36 permutation tests (20,000 iterations, seed 20260908, 1,425 sessions 2021-01-04 -> 2026-09-04); no release-day class separates anywhere, June release days (n=6) are null on all four metrics, and the three sub-0.05 readings are session classes -- all 124 June sessions on VIX close (16.695 vs 18.200, p=0.0028) and quarter-end VIX9D/VIX (last session of a quarter 0.8570 vs 0.9293, p=0.0033). That last one does NOT transfer: 2027-06-29 is the PENULTIMATE session of Q2 2027 and the penultimate class alone is null (p=0.2616). CONTENT: the seasonal hypothesis stays closed and is not re-opened -- but April is the only calendar month of the twelve whose two most recent prints are both negative (2025-04 -0.19%, 2026-04 -0.14%), which makes 'April 2027 m/m positive' the least-supported content bet this chain has registered, and it is registered at the regime's rate with that stated. This edition also carries the one-step restatement of March 2027, first printed 2027-05-25. Same channel caveat as every FHFA entry: symbols is deliberately EMPTY and no house playbook is housing- or macro-keyed (trade-playbooks.md and multi-symbol-sweep.md re-grepped 2026-09-08 for housing/house price/hpi/case-shiller -> 0 hits each). Date is confirmed; nothing here licenses an entry.
